faction_the_office.voice: The Office speaks in stamps, countersignatures, and triplicate. A rejection is a missing seal, not an insult. Every release is logged against your account.
faction_the_office.rejected: Requisition denied — the authorising stamp is absent or the ledger balance does not cover the line item.
faction_the_office.sold: Accepted for inventory. The Office records the transfer and adjusts the manifest accordingly.

faction_the_cutters.voice: The Cutters speak in tonnage and debts. Stock running low is weather coming in. Favours are tracked in ledgers, not sentiment.
faction_the_cutters.rejected: No stock to release and no credit to draw against. The Cutters do not float empty requisitions.
faction_the_cutters.sold: Taken to the pile. The cutter ledger shifts; your credit moves the other way.

faction_the_fleet.voice: The Fleet speaks in manifests, tides, and berths. A completed trade is logged like a vessel cleared to sail. Paper trails matter more than cargo.
faction_the_fleet.rejected: The manifest does not clear. Either the berth is closed or the hold cannot accept the transfer.
faction_the_fleet.sold: Logged and cleared. The Fleet manifest now shows the item transferred to your custody.

items.item_map_sheet_ice_road: The sheet is not a map — it is a promise that the ice will hold long enough to matter.
items.item_census_return_blank: Blanks are cheap until the clerk demands them filled.
items.item_order_12c: Reconstruction Order 12-C: stamped, filed, and quietly ignored until the ice opens.
items.item_allocation_tag: Allocation Tag. What is tagged is owned, and what is owned can be reassigned.
items.item_triplicate_carbon: Triplicate Carbon. One copy for the Office, one for the file, one for the fire.
items.item_ice_spike_bar: Ice Spike Bar. Cold iron for cold work. It dulls faster than steel and lasts longer than hope.
items.item_beacon_oil: Beacon Oil. Burns clean in the lamp but leaves a residue the filters do not catch.
items.item_cutter_ledger_blank: Cutter Ledger (blank). The Cutters do not trust a ledger with writing already on it.
items.item_ice_tyre_set: Ice Tyre Set. The road claims rubber faster than it claims drivers.
items.item_plant_suit_patched: Plant Suit (patched). Every patch is a reminder that the membrane cannot hold forever.
items.item_resin_gloves: Resin Gloves. The resin seals, the gloves chafe, and both are preferable to bare hands on the line.
items.item_fume_rag: Fume Rag. Cheap, replaceable, and the only thing between a man and the resin fumes.
items.item_shift_whistle: Shift Whistle. It does not summon help. It announces that help is expected.
items.item_work_ticket: Work Ticket. Without it, you are just another body in the yard. With it, you are on the roster.
items.item_steam_token: Steam Token. Not money, not scrip — a promise that the plant will turn today.
items.item_block_c_key: Block C Key. It opens one door and signals that the holder has been cleared for what lies beyond.
items.item_ro_resin: RO Resin. The membrane eats it and the plant drinks it. Stock is measured in drums, not grams.
items.item_ro_resin_spent: Spent RO Resin. Heavier than it looks and useless until the chemists find a second pass.
items.item_iodine_crystal: Iodine Crystal. Small enough to hide, strong enough to matter when the plume passes.
items.item_process_barrel: Process Barrel. Sealed, marked, and heavy. What it contains depends on which shift filled it.
items.item_schedule_crystal: Schedule Crystal. The Office keeps time on these. Break one and you buy the next clerk a coffee.
items.item_fleet_pad_copy: Fleet Pad Copy. The Fleet trusts copies more than originals — paper rots, copies multiply.
items.item_foghorn_key: Foghorn Key. Wound once per shift. The sound carries farther than any radio in the valley.
items.item_kittiwake_copy: Kittiwake Copy. A route map that predates the ice. The Fleet keeps it for sentimental reasons.
items.item_weigh_receipt_hf: Weigh Receipt. The bridge does not trust scales; it trusts the stamped receipt from the scales.
items.item_schedule_sector4_copy: The Other Schedule. Sector 4 runs on a different clock. The Office finds this inconvenient.
items.item_halvard_kit_notes: Improvised Potable. Not clean, not safe, and better than nothing when the barrel runs dry.
items.item_sole_unsigned: Filed, Not Signed. The gap between filing and signature is where most corruption lives.
items.item_playground_seat: One Seat. Cold steel, bolted down. The only furniture in the yard that does not get moved.
items.item_edor_return_self: Clerk's Own Return. Edor does not file this. Edor keeps it.
items.item_yara_dark_mark: Dark Mark. Not a brand, not a tattoo — a notation in the clerk's private ledger.
items.item_leva_minutes_vol12: Volume 12. Leva's minutes run to handwriting, not type. The Clerk respects the volume.
items.item_hearth4_hatch_log: Hatch Log. Hearth 4. The hatch that opens onto the ice. The log is supposed to be signed.
items.item_alloc7_ration_tin: ALLOC-7 Tin. The label says ration. The content says starch and regret.
items.item_cluster_formulary: Human Formulary. Written for Cluster 12, applied wherever the medics have paper and light.
items.item_foghorn_timer: Foghorn Escapement. The mechanism that turns air into sound. Precision engineering in a salt world.
items.item_tin_fourteenth: The Fourteenth Plate. The fourteenth allocation that never received its tin. The Office still lists it.
items.item_salt_rash_salve: Salt-Rash Salve. The air here eats skin. The salve slows the eating.
items.item_uv_grease: UV Grease. Applied to gaskets and seals. It smells like chemistry and looks like grey paste.
items.item_electrolyte_salts: Electrolyte Salts. The body demands them; the ration does not supply them.
